name: decisionkit
description: Provider-neutral decision tool: ask Jev (TypeSafe AI) or the OpenAI Decisions API closed-form questions and get probabilities back.

provider.title: Decision provider
provider.description: Which external API receives your decision requests: jev (TypeSafe AI directly), openrouter (Jev served and billed by OpenRouter), or openai (OpenAI Decisions API, beta). Requests contain the context Claude writes into each call.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe (Jev) API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Needed only when provider is jev. Create one at console.typesafe.ai/keys. Stored in your OS secure store.

openrouter_api_key.title: OpenRouter API key
openrouter_api_key.description: Needed only when provider is openrouter. Stored in your OS secure store. Your shell's OPENROUTER_API_KEY is never used.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key
openai_api_key.description: Needed only when provider is openai. Stored in your OS secure store. Your shell's OPENAI_API_KEY is never used.

model.title: Model (optional)
model.description: Leave blank for the default: jev-latest or gpt-6-luna. Pin e.g. jev-1.13.0 for reproducible results.

timeout_ms.title: Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: Total time allowed per decision, including retries.

usage_log.title: Local usage log
usage_log.description: Record ids, timings, token counts and estimated cost (never prompt content) for the status tool.

status.content: Call the decisionkit `status` tool and summarize for me: the active provider and model, whether it is ready (and the config error if not), the connectivity check, and usage totals. Do not call `decide`.
status.description: Show decisionkit's provider, connectivity and usage
